verdict.rationale: Reclaim has a first-party help article on how its pricing and plans work, and it states that the Lite tier is free for any single user with essential smart time-blocking features. Nothing in the pack shows actual per-seat prices or what each paid tier includes. missing for 10: published per-seat dollar prices for paid tiers, tier-by-tier feature inclusions, evidence that pricing is visible without contacting sales, independent corroboration.
